text.en: This session: meet, trade, team up, explore or take tasks. Over days: break through and climb the weekly organization board. Returning after over 10 ticks offline? Check briefing in the first successful action envelope or enter resume result. Talk freely; speech alone gives no cultivation. Eligible transfers, player bounties, shared monster kills and lessons with players or officials reward both. Unrepelled beast tides spread, cutting new system-task rewards by 20%. Travel may bring a personal encounter. When daily system-task rewards reach zero, task returns a hint.
text.zh-CN: 本次找人交流成交、结伴、探索或接差事；几天内为组织争周榜、破境。离线超过10刻回来，先看首个成功动作信封或enter resume结果的briefing。随时自由聊天，空聊不发修为；与玩家或官方人物完成合格交付、悬赏、同杀或授技，双方可获论道修为。兽潮不打退会扩散，使受灾区新系统差事报酬降低两成；旅途中偶遇个人小事。系统差事当日收益归零时，task回包带hint。
